documents.title: Master Service Agreement
documents.focus: Payment deadlines, onboarding scope, and service-level commitments.
documents.content:
MASTER SERVICE AGREEMENT

1 Scope
The platform subscription covers onboarding support, workspace access, and monthly operational review meetings.

2 Payment Terms
Invoices must be paid within 15 days of receipt. Late payment pauses new onboarding requests after written notice.

3 Service Levels
Priority one incidents require an initial response within 30 minutes and executive escalation within 2 hours.

documents.title: Incident Response Playbook
documents.focus: Escalation flow, bridge ownership, and retention of response evidence.
documents.content:
INCIDENT RESPONSE PLAYBOOK

1 Severity Model
Severity one incidents affect all customers and require immediate triage.

2 Escalation
Severity one incidents require a bridge commander within 10 minutes and executive notification within 30 minutes.

3 Evidence Retention
Chat transcripts, incident timelines, and postmortem approvals are retained for 7 years.
